native_reserve.scope: Uniform original-host native two-core reserve completion: actual disjoint compressed reserves, rounded and protected native multiplicities, original-copy boundary realization, robust core completions, and an actual regular non-overfull residual retaining robust embedded cores. The surviving linear reserve and h-r margin are derived from original-host assumptions. Supporting progress toward Corollary 4.6; palette grouping, the full two-core factorization, and the main theorem remain incomplete.

publication.note: This report precedes branch updates and makes no claim that those updates succeeded.
